title: Ethanol Transfer Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Place the USA Scientific 12‑Well Reservoir with ethanol in slots 1‑4, load Opentrons 20 µL tip rack in slot 3, mount the Opentrons Magnetic Module with a NEST 96‑Well Plate in slot 4, and arrange any remaining labware as shown in the deck map.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file to your computer (see the provided link or article for help).

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons OT‑2 Run App and upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2 App, calibrate the reservoir, tip rack, magnetic module, and the P300 and P20 multi‑channel pipettes according to the on‑screen instructions.

steps.title: Start the run
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 App to begin execution of the protocol.

steps.title: First ethanol addition
steps.instruction: Using the P300 multi‑channel pipette, dispense 150 µL of ethanol into each well of the 96‑well plate.

steps.title: Incubate ethanol
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol for 30 seconds to allow the ethanol to sit in the wells.

steps.title: First ethanol removal
steps.instruction: Aspirate the 150 µL of ethanol from each well with the P300 multi‑channel pipette and discard the used tips.

steps.title: Second ethanol addition
steps.instruction: Repeat the addition: dispense 150 µL of ethanol into each well using the P300 multi‑channel pipette.

steps.title: Second ethanol removal
steps.instruction: Aspirate the ethanol from each well with the P300 multi‑channel pipette and discard the tips.

steps.title: Aspirate residual liquid
steps.instruction: Using the P20 multi‑channel pipette, aspirate 15 µL of liquid from each well and discard the tips.
